description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalalpitiya, Attanagalla D/S DIvision, Gampaha District  - Cad. Map No. 510600
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, owners, land extent, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
